items.title: Ukrainian suspect hunted by police after Monaco bomb attack was 'disguised as a man'
items.description: Officials believe the suspect may not have acted alone and spent days casing out the scene of the attack.

items.title: Polish PM warns critical months ahead in face of Russian threat
items.description: Tusk says Poland is preparing for "various" scenarios after media reports of a planned Russian attack.

items.title: France records 2,025 excess deaths at peak of heatwave as Europe braces for more extreme weather
items.description: Forecasters are warning of further extreme temperatures on the continent in the next few days.

items.title: Anguished families left to identify Venezuela quake victims at makeshift morgue
items.description: The disaster has overwhelmed local services, with bodies put outside or in tents for identification.

items.title: Iran begins public mourning for Ayatollah killed in February
items.description: Ali Khamenei's body will lie in state in Tehran's Grand Mosalla from Friday ahead of days-long funeral events.

items.title: German row over plan for workers to need sick note on first day of illness
items.description: A doctors' group says it "borders on madness" that patients will have to obtain the note in person.

items.title: Nasa launches mission to save falling space telescope
items.description: A Nasa-funded robot has blasted off to catch a falling telescope in mid-orbit and blast it back to safety before it burns up.

items.title: Stand-up comic held for jokes about Erdoğan and Islam in Turkey crackdown
items.description: Deniz Göktaş is regarded as one of Turkey's most popular comedians and is accused of "inciting hatred and hostility" on stage.

items.title: Zuma showing South Africa 'middle finger' by meeting Gupta brother - minister
items.description: Former President Zuma's trip to India reignites anger over a decade-old corruption scandal.

items.title: Dissident Hong Kong bookseller Lam Wing-kee dies aged 70
items.description: Lam Wing-kee, who defied China by selling material critical of Beijing, passed away after suffering from lung cancer.

items.title: US withdraws troops from Nigeria after Islamic State mission
items.description: The US said the joint operation, which began in December last year, was a success.

items.title: Venezuela quake survivor pulled out alive after eight days
items.description: Hernán Gil was trapped under a collapsed multi-storey car park.
